facts.summary: New apps and updates must target API 35 by August 31, 2025.
Existing apps below the current discoverability threshold can be hidden from new users on newer Android versions; by August 31, 2025 that threshold is API 34+.
When targeting Android 16, predictive back is on by default and android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback acts as a temporary opt-out.
Android 16 ignores orientation, resizability, and aspect ratio restrictions on sw >= 600dp displays by default, with a temporary opt-out through API 36 and removal planned in API 37.
Apps targeting Android 15+ on 64-bit devices must support 16 KB page sizes for new apps and updates starting November 1, 2025.
AndroidX security-crypto APIs are deprecated in Security 1.1.0.
